text:
anya: Quick design check multi-column Create Job form. We keep getting reports that inline error copy clutters the grid and makes rows taller. Idea: show a small error "pill" (icon + short label) inline on desktop, and expand to full error text on focus or on mobile. Thoughts? tom: Pill sounds promising for scanability. Make it keyboard-focusable and tie it to an accessible tooltip (aria-describedby) so screen readers get the expanded text. No hover-only behavior. rachel: Agree on focusable pills. Important: when keyboard focuses the field, reveal the full message below the field (not only in tooltip) so folks tabbing through see the context. liam: Alternative for required markers: instead of asterisk could we use a tiny "Req" badge after the label? Shorter for translations and more explicit than color alone. Would still need sr-only text for screen readers. anya: Love the "Req" badge idea. Visual badge + hidden text works. Also thinking of an opt-in compact mode where pills are default, but product teams can opt-in for expanded inline errors for high-security forms. rachel: Accessibility nit: if we hide the full message behind a tooltip, ensure aria-live updates when the message becomes visible so screen readers announce it. Use aria-atomic=true for the live region. tom: Small code hint for the pill pattern: ```
Full error message here.
``` liam: For destructive confirmations: security suggested typed-confirm for big deletes. Instead of typing full name, what about a combined pattern: checkbox "I understand" + type last 4 characters of resource id. Less error-prone for long names but still deliberate. anya: I like that. It reduces typing burden but still forces intent. Allow paste? I'm leaning yes, but we can surface a small "pasted" indicator so users see they pasted rather than typed. rachel: Do not block paste. Also ensure server-side normalization (trim/unicode) and final validation. Front-end can be permissive but server must be authoritative. Log attempts for audit. tom: Copy suggestion for modal: "This will permanently delete 'model-2026-xyz'. Check the box and enter the last 4 characters (e.g., '8f4a') to confirm." Keep it explicit and short. liam: One more: animations. If the pill expands into full text, prefer fade-in and respect prefers-reduced-motion. And make sure the live region update is immediate (not delayed by animation) so screen readers don't miss it. anya: Quick decision summary: 1) desktop: compact error pill (focusable) that reveals full text on focus; mobile: show inline full text by default; 2) visible "Req" badge + sr-only "Required" token for screen readers; 3) use role=status + aria-live=polite for field messages and aria-atomic on those regions; 4) destructive confirm = checkbox + type-last-4-chars pattern (allow paste, show pasted indicator, server-side normalize & audit); 5) animations allowed but must respect reduced-motion and not delay live-region updates. Any objections? liam: +1 rachel: +1 tom: +1 anya: I'll put up a small prototype (desktop + mobile) and a PR with copy variants and implementation notes. Will tag eng + security + intl. design-bot: Created PR #3244 forms/error-pill-pattern + typed-confirm flow (assigned to anya).
